questions.q: Per this lesson, how does endorsement differ from a workspace role or an item permission?
options: It's a signal flagging which self-service items are worth building on, not a gate controlling who can access something
It is functionally identical to a workspace role, just with a different name
It replaces the need for any item permissions entirely
It only applies to items nobody has permission to view
questions.explain: Roles and permissions are gates deciding access; endorsement is a separate signal pointing people at the items worth using.

questions.q: Who can apply the Promoted badge to an item, per this lesson?
options: Any owner or anyone with write permission on that item
Only a tenant-wide Fabric administrator
Only Microsoft support staff
Nobody — Promoted is applied automatically by the system
questions.explain: Promoted is deliberately low-bar — a self-service signal any owner or write-permission holder can set on their own item.

questions.q: Why can't an item's own owner certify it themselves, per this lesson?
options: Certification requires being on an admin-authorized list of reviewers, separate from simply owning the item
Owners are always automatically certified reviewers for their own items
Certification doesn't exist as a concept distinct from Promoted
Only Microsoft itself can certify any Fabric item
questions.explain: Certified means an admin has specifically authorized that person as a reviewer — ownership alone doesn't grant that authority.

questions.q: What kind of item can carry the Master Data badge, per this lesson?
options: Only items that actually hold data, such as a lakehouse, warehouse, or semantic model
Any Fabric item at all, including reports and dashboards
Only Power BI dashboards specifically
Only items created by a tenant admin personally
questions.explain: Master Data is reserved for items that hold data; a report or dashboard can't carry that badge.

questions.q: What does the admin portal's Certification setting control, per this lesson?
options: Whether certification is enabled tenant-wide and exactly who is authorized to apply it
Which specific items get certified automatically
The visual color of the Certified badge
Whether Promoted badges can ever be removed
questions.explain: Certification is off by default; an admin deliberately enables it and scopes who, across the tenant, can grant it.
